notes.title: Steam Playtest - Patch Notes 0.2.5α
notes.notes:
What's up, players? Crit Team dropping in! Sorry about the long wait. We've had too much on our plate over the past two months. But thank goodness, we've now finally broken free from those chores, phew! With that, we bring you the 0.2.5α update. This marks the start of another long-term maintenance. We'll be pushing forward with subsequent updates as soon as possible to refine the game's overall framework. Fingers crossed you dig it.


New FeaturesSystem
Different search points now have distinct SFX/background panels.

Shelf-type search points now visually reflect loot richness.

Suppressor-type muzzle attachments now modify gunfire sounds.


Dual Crosshair Aiming
We noticed players occasionally lost track of their aim position while using auto-aim, resulting in missed tracking. The new dual crosshair system addresses this by locking the internal aim to targets and continuously showing the player's actual cursor position externally.


New Map
\[Origin-00-1963] Burning Grove 

Players must complete a series of linear missions to unlock this new map.


New Abnormal Status
Burned: Causes continuous damage.

Fire Field: You are in a fire field, affected by smoke and heat.

Smoke: Accelerates stamina cost and causes continuous damage.

Scorch: Causes continuous damage.

Filtered Air: Safeguards your respiratory system from environmental hazards but increases stamina cost

High Heat Protection: Insulates you from high temperatures, enabling uninterrupted operation in extreme heat.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/47206e1e2af74d10aa91aec787663599ba382f6f.png"]Optimized stage selection screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/d5b5f5e45574e8e6e871676b71314349cf3dfeba.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/361cc322dbce3db93fce122e8120aa6cf141fdf1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/8d12c940c6d77de6be3e18c882026be4459613a5.png"]Fixes
Hit effects are now triggered via server notification instead of client-side, providing clearer hit feedback.

Fixed a duplicated English localization string.

Fixed several errors in English localization.

Added missing localization texts.

Attempted to fix an invisible wall near the valley.

Fixed a cursor display issue on the U.R.C. terminal screen.

Fixed the Gunsmith issue on the transmitter panel.

Fixed a bug where shooting could result in negative XP.

Fixed missing models in some search points.

Fixed a missing wall in the safehouse.

Fixed a confusing guide instruction in the new player tutorial.

Fixed an issue where the furious status of Scary Highlander was lost. Mycomarked will now enrage Scary Highlander and enhance their abilities.

Note: We know this update lacks substantial new content. Our upcoming development focus will revolve around content expansion.
